decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing various Elemental creatures and powerful spells to manipulate the board state and disrupt the opponent's strategy. This is achieved through a combination of card draw, removal, and protection provided by cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Solitude. The Elemental synergy allows for efficient mana ramp and card advantage, leading to overwhelming board presence with powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and maintain control until it can secure a win condition.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game, while leveraging cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Persist to generate additional value. Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality help disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push provide removal options. The inclusion of cards like Bitter Reunion and Wrenn and Six add consistency to the deck, with support from lands like Boseiju, Who Endures to protect key spells. The deck aims to be proactive and creative in its approach to winning the game.

This deck focuses on casting spells with Cascade to quickly put out powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cascade into its key threats while also disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Negation. The inclusion of versatile spells like Prismari Command and flexible lands like Gemstone Caverns allow for adaptability in different matchups. Utilizing a mix of control and aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its fast, efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. It utilizes powerful cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure, while also using cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to deal with threats, and uses cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its creatures and generate value. Overall, this deck aims to be fast and efficient, ending the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing creative combos to disrupt and overwhelm opponents. By using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding, the player aims to control the game and generate powerful advantages. The inclusion of creatures like Archon of Cruelty and planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional ways to dominate the battlefield. By combining powerful spells and creatures, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through unique and unexpected strategies.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells and creature abilities while also generating value through cards like Risen Reef and Wrenn and Six. The Elementals synergize well with each other and provide a strong late-game presence. Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the various colors needed for the deck's spells.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponents with efficient counterspells. Mishra's Bauble and Consider help dig for key cards, while Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt provide removal for opposing threats. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent serve as aggressive win conditions, with support from Dragon's Rage Channeler and Brazen Borrower. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the board through a mix of tempo plays and card advantage. It prioritizes proactive plays and adaptability to outmaneuver opponents in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using a combination of cards to set up a powerful combo that allows the player to creatively control the game. By utilizing cards like Archon of Cruelty, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Indomitable Creativity, the player can disrupt their opponent's strategy and gain a significant advantage. This archetype requires strategic thinking and careful planning to execute the combo effectively, making it a challenging and rewarding deck to play in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This aggressive deck focuses on quickly reducing its own life total to strengthen Death's Shadow, a powerful and cheap creature that grows stronger as the player's life total decreases. The deck utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand and disrupt their strategy while also utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure and set up quick kills. The inclusion of Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional versatility and power to the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing fast Eldrazi creatures and powerful artifacts to apply pressure on the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer, while also ramping up its own board presence with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Reality Smasher. The inclusion of cards like Expedition Map and Urza's Saga helps to search for key lands or artifacts needed for the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a mix of strong creatures and disruptive elements.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using a combination of powerful Elemental creatures and control spells. The deck aims to generate value through cards like Wrenn and Six and Risen Reef, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Solitude. The deck also has access to powerful finishers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game. The mana base is built to support the deck's powerful spells and ensure consistency in casting them.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to equip it for massive damage. Esper Sentinel helps control the opponent's spells while Urza's Saga provides additional tutors for artifacts. The deck also includes evasion with Inkmoth Nexus and other equipment like Nettlecyst and Sword of Fire and Ice to provide additional threats. With efficient mana production and protection from Giver of Runes, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful equipment combos.

This deck focuses on quickly aggroing the opponent with a mix of creatures and spells. It utilizes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to pressure the opponent early on. The deck also includes disruption in the form of cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, the deck can deal with threats efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Undying Malice and Agadeem's Awakening provide resilience and card advantage. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay with a mix of burn spells and low-cost creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Mutagenic Growth and Lightning Bolt to remove threats and control the board while cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Sprite Dragon deal consistent damage. The addition of Underworld Breach allows for graveyard recursion and extra value. The mana base is designed for efficiency, with a focus on red mana sources to ensure the deck can cast its spells quickly and effectively.

The deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent while steadily building up resources through card draw and graveyard recursion. This allows for efficient use of mana and the ability to apply early pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and a steady stream of threats, utilizing counterspells and removal to protect its own board presence and maintain control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to have a diverse range of powerful creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By including high-value creatures like Scion of Draco, Nishoba Brawler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, as well as efficient removal and countermagic spells, the deck can apply early pressure and maintain control of the board. The inclusion of Tribal Flames and Leyline Binding further enhances the deck's ability to deal damage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck's mana base is built to support its multicolored requirements for maximum efficiency.

This Bant Control deck focuses on manipulating the board state and disrupting the opponent's plans through a combination of control spells and flickering effects. Key cards include Teferi, Time Raveler and Ephemerate, which provide temporary solutions to threats and can be used to reuse powerful ETB effects. Additionally, the deck utilizes Wall creatures and Soulherder to generate card advantage and maintain control over the battlefield. The mana base includes a variety of utility lands to provide flexibility and support the deck's control strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, generating card advantage and eventually winning the game. It includes efficient mana sources and disruption spells to protect the combo and control the game state. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early pressure and serve as additional win conditions. Teferi, Time Raveler can be used to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful interactions.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach in combination with Grinding Station and artifacts like Mishra's Bauble to generate a loop and mill cards from the opponent's library. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide additional card advantage and pressure, while Thassa's Oracle serves as a win condition to ensure victory once the opponent's library is depleted. Teferi, Time Raveler is included to protect the combo from disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.

The deck focuses on using control elements to stall the game while ramping up mana through cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. By utilizing cards like Scapeshift and Bring to Light, the player can search for key pieces like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Omnath, Locus of Creation to deal massive amounts of damage quickly. Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler help control the board, while Wrenn and Six provide additional card advantage. The deck aims to control the game until it can assemble the necessary pieces to win efficiently.
